# Brown Eyed Flower Child

> > A travel and lifestyle blog by Taylor Deer featuring destination guides, pop culture travel experiences, and small-town adventures.

Brown Eyed Flower Child offers curated travel itineraries and unique experiences, from TV-inspired road trips like Gilmore Girls filming locations in Connecticut to international adventures in Peru, Northern Italy, and Switzerland. The site blends wanderlust with nostalgia, focusing on both bucket-list destinations and charming local discoveries.

## Key Topics

- Taylor Deer
- Travel guides and itineraries
- Gilmore Girls filming locations
- Connecticut small-town tourism
- Peru travel (Machu Picchu, Cusco, Rainbow Mountain)
- Northern Italy and Switzerland
- Stars Hollow-inspired destinations
- Holiday and Christmas road trips
- First-time destination planning
- Hiking and trekking adventures
- TV and pop culture tourism
- Lake Como and Cinque Terre
- Lima and Zurich
- Boutique travel experiences

- [Where to go in Northern Italy and Switzerland](https://browneyedflowerchild.com/web-stories/where-to-go-in-northern-italy-and-switzerland): Northern Italy & Switzerland itinerary: Zurich, Lake Como, Cinque Terre
